items.question: The houses in our street are (brightly-lit / old-fashioned) on the full moon day of Thadingyut.

items.question: We have this spacious hall. We knocked two rooms into one. (Combine the sentences using ‘by + V-ing’ construction.)

items.question: Our teacher tried to finish marking our essays. She stayed behind after office hours yesterday. (Combine the sentences using ‘by + V-ing’ construction.)

items.question: Mg Mg walked to school. He whistled and swung his school bag. (Combine the sentences using ‘V-ing’ construction.)
